Configuring all Microsoft APIs in MCP server

features.name: All Microsoft published APIs available in MCP server
features.description: All Microsoft published APIs are now available in the MCP server, including subscription billing, e-invoicing, automation APIs, and any API that has a published Microsoft endpoint.

features.name: Add tools by API group in MCP configuration
features.description: Users can add APIs to MCP server configuration either one by one or by using the add tools by API group action to bulk-add all APIs in a group.
caveats: Users can set permissions to read-only or other levels if the API supports them

features.name: API groups for automation, e-document, and intercompany
features.description: API groups are now available for analytics, automation APIs, e-document, intercompany, and other functional areas, allowing bulk configuration of related APIs.
features.status_evidence_quote: analytics, automation APIs, e-document, intercompany, um everything that we have an API group for is now available

features.name: MCP server support in 2026 wave one release
features.description: MCP server enhancements shipped in April 2026 release, with additional APIs and query support being added in version 28.2.
caveats: Multiple videos needed to understand full capabilities including API queries
